title: Connectors: 不过, 要不, 另外 / 再说, 结果, 后来, 之前 / 之后, 以来
description: A softer but, 'how about', in addition / besides, as a result, later on (past), before / after, and since.

points.title: 不过: but (softer)
points.summary: 不过 (búguò) = 'but, however' — milder than 但是, common in speech.
points.body: - 这家饭馆的菜很好吃，**不过**有点儿贵.
examples: I'd like to go, but I don't have time today.

points.title: 要不 … 吧: how about …
points.summary: 要不 (yàobù) + suggestion + 吧 = 'then how about …?'.
points.body: - 今天太热了，**要不**我们去游泳**吧**.
examples: How about you go back first?

points.title: 另外 / 再说: in addition, besides
points.summary: 另外 (lìngwài) adds another point. 再说 (zàishuō) adds another **reason** ('besides, …').
points.body:
- 这个房子太小了，**另外**离公司也很远.
- 我不想去，太远了，**再说**我也没时间.
examples: Besides, I don't have time anyway.

points.title: 结果: as a result, in the end
points.summary: 结果 (jiéguǒ) introduces the outcome — often an unwanted or unexpected one.
points.body: - 他没带伞，**结果**被雨淋湿了.
examples: {我|wǒ}{等|děng}{了|le}{他|tā}{一个|yí ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}，{结果|jiéguǒ}{他|tā}{没|méi}{来|lái}。
I waited an hour for him, and in the end he didn't come.

points.title: 后来 vs 以后
points.summary: 后来 (hòulái) = afterwards, later on — **past** narratives only, stands alone. 以后 = after (an event) or 'in future'.
points.body:
- 我们大学时是好朋友，**后来**他去了美国.
- **以后**我想去中国工作.
examples: Later on he went to America.

points.title: Event + 之前 / 之后: before / after
points.summary: 之前 = before, 之后 = after (a bit more formal than 以前 / 以后).
points.body:
- 睡觉**之前**，别喝咖啡.
- 吃完饭**之后**，我们去散步吧.

points.title: … 以来: since
points.summary: Time / event + 以来 (yǐlái) = since then, up to now.
points.body:
- 来中国**以来**，我交了很多朋友.
- 今年**以来** (since the start of this year).
examples: {来|lái}{中国|Zhōngguó}{以来|yǐlái}，{我|wǒ}{交|jiāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{朋友|péngyou}。
Since coming to China I've made lots of friends.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fànguǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎochī}，（　）{有点儿|yǒudiǎnr}{贵|guì}。
notes: 而且 = 'and also' — 有点儿贵 is a drawback.
questions.translation: The food in this restaurant is good, but a bit pricey.

notes: 不过 can't split the verb phrase.
不过 starts the second clause.
不过 starts the second clause.
questions.translation: I'd like to go, but I don't have time today.
It's so hot today — how about we go swimming?

questions.prompt: What does 「{要不|yàobù}{你|nǐ}{先|xiān}{回去|huíqù}{吧|ba}。」 mean?
notes: 要不 here is a suggestion, not 'otherwise'.

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{房子|fángzi}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}，（　）{离|lí}{公司|gōngsī}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{远|yuǎn}。
notes: 所以 = 'so' — the distance isn't a result of the size.
questions.translation: This flat is too small, and on top of that it's far from the office.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{太|tài}{远|yuǎn}{了|le}，（　）{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{没有|méiyǒu}{时间|shíjiān}。
questions.translation: I don't want to go — it's too far, and besides I don't have time.

notes: 不过 = 'but' — getting wet isn't a contrast.
questions.translation: He didn't take an umbrella and got soaked.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{等|děng}{了|le}{他|tā}{一个|yí ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}，（　）{他|tā}{没|méi}{来|lái}。
notes: 原来 = discovering a fact — here it's the outcome.
questions.translation: I waited an hour for him, and in the end he didn't come.

questions.prompt: {我们|wǒmen}{上|shàng}{大学|dàxué}{的|de}{时候|shíhou}{是|shì}{好|hǎo}{朋友|péngyou}，（　）{他|tā}{去|qù}{了|le}{美国|Měiguó}，{就|jiù}{不|bù}{常|cháng}{联系|liánxì}{了|le}。
notes: 以前 = 'before' — but this happened after university.
最近 = 'recently' — doesn't fit the story.
刚才 = 'a moment ago' — not years later.
questions.translation: We were good friends at university; later he went to America and we lost touch.

notes: 已经 can't start the sentence like this.
后来 is only for the past.
questions.translation: In future, I want to work in China.

notes: 后来 can't follow a verb.
后来 can't follow a verb.
questions.translation: Let's go for a walk after dinner.

notes: 后来 can't follow a verb.
Before coming to China, you couldn't make friends there.
questions.translation: Since coming to China I've made lots of friends.
